_note: 1.16.0 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_dynamic_ambience.md). Single source for the engine's ambience (gen_engine.py injects it). levels: 0 empty, 1 quiet, 2 some people, 3 busy, 4 packed. blocks: 00-06, 06-08, P1 08-10, P2 10-12, lunch 12-13, P3 13-16, 16-18, 18-20, 20-24. rhythm: class = Mon-Fri with classes, sat = Saturday (optional), free = Sunday and days without classes. places: lowercase place names as the engine's placeKey gives them. sun: mid-month sunrise and sunset in minutes (about 48 degrees north, sun time, no daylight saving; M1 = March). cues/beats: [category or *, kind, type text, conditions]. Types, not finished sentences: the narrator writes the detail each time (owner). Conditions: out (true outdoors / false indoors), tb (time bands dawn, morning, day, evening, night), wx (rain, snow, wind, fog, storm, heat, cold, clear), season, min/max (crowd), far (allowed at an empty place), curfew (allowed outside the dorms after curfew), exam (exam week), flu, special (overheard, weather_turn, event_echo). 1.85.0: ev (event ids: only on that event's days, and then picked first six times in ten; the Thinning's beats, lore 9: never a breach or a Clue). uncanny: the secret roll's stories (lore uids), with where and when.
_lore_chance: 1.24.0 (owner playtest): percent chance that a non-calm ambience beat at a place with lore {{user}} has not heard becomes that lore, overheard (once a day at most).
_lore_places: 1.31.0 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_location_activities.md): talk carries under running water. At these places the lore chance is this, and a non-calm beat is a rumour overheard at the same chance.
_pairs: 1.51.0 (audit/AUDIT_2026-10-03_4_batch_fitur.md batch 3, audit 4.8): two NPCs {{user}} has met, seen together the way the Connections panel shows them (friends, rivals, dislike from data/relations.json, only lines {{user}} can see there, both free by whereabouts). seen: a Meanwhile Journal line (a bond unseen for a week) at a haunt; near: an ambience beat at a place one of them haunts. rate: the chance when one fits; at most one a day. Generic, written by the maintainer: public behaviour only, never a secret.
